# openai_mcp_tunnel (Data Source)

Retrieve an MCP tunnel registration by ID using an organization admin API key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openai_mcp_tunnel" "example" {
  id = "tunnel_00000000000000000000000000000001"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Tunnel identifier.

### Read-Only

- `creator` (String) creator
- `description` (String) description
- `name` (String) name
- `organization_ids` (List of String) organization ids
- `tenant_ids` (List of String) tenant ids
- `workspace_ids` (List of String) workspace ids
